devLogin.label: Dev sign-in
devLogin.hint: Until Microsoft sign-in arrives, pick which company and person you are.

place.noFloors: This building has no floors yet.

people.title: People
people.dragHint: Drag a person onto a seat to assign them.

map.empty: This floor has no seats yet.

seat.title: Seat {label}
seat.blockedInfo: This seat is blocked and can’t be assigned.
seat.reservePlaceholder: Who is it for? e.g. New hire
seat.viewOnly: View only — ask an editor to make changes.

details.emptyBody: Click a seat to see who sits there and its history, or drag a person from the list onto a free seat.

editor.measure: Set scale with a known length (M)
editor.pan: Hold Space and drag to move around
editor.hintSelect: Click to select · Shift-click to add · drag a box to select several · arrows nudge
editor.hintSeat: Click to place a seat · Esc when done
editor.hintRoom: Click each corner · double-click or click the first corner to finish · Esc to cancel
editor.hintRect: Drag to draw a rectangular room
editor.hintMeasure: Drag along something whose real length you know, e.g. a wall
editor.freeFirst: Free or cancel the reservation on {labels} first — seats with people can’t be deleted.
editor.accessibleList: Rooms and seats on this floor

inspector.name: Name
inspector.planHint: PNG, JPG or WebP, up to 10 MB. Draw rooms and seats on top of it.
inspector.scaleUnset: Not set. Use the ruler tool to measure a known length.
inspector.deleteFloorBody: Only empty floors can be deleted. Remove its rooms and seats first.
inspector.deleteBuildingBody: Only buildings without floors can be deleted.
inspector.label: Label
inspector.blockedHint: Blocked seats can’t be assigned (e.g. broken, reserved for visitors).
inspector.occupied: Someone sits here — free the seat in View mode to change this.
inspector.scaleDialogTitle: How long is this line in reality?
inspector.scaleDialogBody: The line is {units} units long on the plan. Enter its real length to set the floor’s scale.

auth.signInBody: Use your work account. Seatline works with Microsoft 365.

errors.expired: That sign-in took too long. Please try again.
errors.invalid: Microsoft’s answer couldn’t be verified. Please try again.
errors.failed: Sign-in didn’t work. Please try again.

auth.onboardingTitle: Set up Seatline for your organisation
auth.onboardingBody: Nobody from your organisation uses Seatline yet. Create its workspace — you’ll be its first admin, and colleagues who sign in later join automatically.
auth.noAccessBody: Your organisation uses Seatline, but you don’t have access. Ask one of its Seatline admins to give you a role.
auth.inactiveBody: Your account is marked as no longer with the organisation. If this is wrong, ask a Seatline admin.
auth.privacy: Seatline stores your name, e-mail, department and job title from Microsoft 365, in Switzerland.

admin.title: People & access
admin.accessViewer: Everyone in the organisation can view the map
admin.accessInvited: Only people you give a role
admin.accessHint: Applies to people who join from now on. Change existing people below.
admin.notConnected: This workspace isn’t connected to Microsoft 365 (demo or local workspace).
admin.consentNeeded: Seatline needs permission to read your organisation’s directory. A Microsoft 365 admin approves this once.
admin.syncHint: Syncs every night. Only name, e-mail, department and job title are copied. People who leave lose their seat; their history stays.
admin.onlyAdmins: Only admins can open this page.
